title: Chinese remainder quotient product for pairwise coprime ideals
statement: For a finite family $(I_i)_{i\in\iota}$ of pairwise coprime ideals in a commutative ring $A$, the canonical map $A/\bigcap_i I_i\to\prod_{i\in\iota}A/I_i$, $[a]\mapsto([a]\bmod I_i)_i$, is a ring isomorphism.
